name: kh-re-coded-vita
description: Port of Decompilation of Kingdom Hearts - RE:CODED to PS VITA
long_description: An experimental native PS Vita port of the European Nintendo DS release. It recompiles the ARM9 game code from the Re:coded decompilation for Vita and provides a compatibility layer for DS graphics, audio, input, and cartridge access. vitaGL drives rendering on the Vita GPU. The port reads game data from your own cartridge dump at runtime.
